reason: The README clearly describes a media-oriented plugin that reads images, uses OpenRouter vision models to generate descriptions, and integrates those descriptions into chat requests for text-only models.

summaries.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 视觉模型为文本模型提供图片描述和图片理解能力的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that uses OpenRouter vision models to provide image descriptions and image understanding for text-only models.

capabilities: Reads image files from local disk for description
Sends image data to OpenRouter vision models
Converts images to text descriptions for models without image input support
Writes a default provider configuration to the DSH settings file
